text: Very strong bull case: ES holds/recovers 7797. From there ES can continue to work up to 7815-20, where there is a large resistance now also. Above there ES can break out to 7828, 7836, then 7844 — react there, then onto 7877.
Reclaims of 7797 remain of interest. 7797 is the first support down: a shelf of lows here comprising the noon Thursday low and the Friday low, about a point apart.

source_quote: This structure technically has two supports. One at 7724 which was the shelf of lows all last week, and then the actual channel suppport which is way down at 7695. We could dip to 7695 and not invalidate the structure.
text: Structure: after the 400+ point rally to start August, ES built a bull flag — the yellow downsloping channel — mostly 7797 down to 7675/7676, with 7724 the major shelf in the middle. Bull-case supports are 7724 and 7676; resistance is 7797. The channel's actual support is way down at 7695: ES could dip to 7695 and not invalidate the structure. Last Thursday ES pushed out of the flag; today it retraced.

trigger.condition_text: flag structure intact while ES holds above 7695

source_quote: Bear case tomorrow: Begins below 7726. These types of level loss shorts below a support are called breakdown trades.
text: Bear case begins below 7726 — a breakdown trade (advanced setup; low win rate, high R/R; Mancini does not take these). Ideally ES puts in a final bounce here, or a Failed Breakdown, then one shorts beneath the lows of that bounce. Likely 7720 trigger down.

trigger.condition_text: ES loses 7726 after a final bounce or failed breakdown; 7720 the likely trigger down

source_quote: My general lean is ES can defend/recover 7797 with targets being 7815-20, 7844, then 7877.
text: In summary: my general lean is ES can defend/recover 7797 with targets being 7815-20, 7844, then 7877.

source_quote: For those who want to short though, 7815-20 and 7844 are spots to try.
text: For those who short (Mancini does not — no short in over a year), 7815-20 and 7844 are the spots to try.

source_quote: Since then, we’ve been chopping again mostly 7797 to 7820.
text: Since the flag breakout and Friday's backtest, ES has been chopping mostly 7797 to 7820 — Mode 2 rangebound action: wait on the Failed Breakdowns, manage level to level, leave a runner; when the range breaks, it breaks, no prediction needed.

source_quote: We remained in what I’ve been calling “ultra low volatility summer chop”.
text: Ultra low volatility summer chop remains the condition: price drifts, traps, has difficulty moving more than a level or two and often takes hours to do it. You can still trade, but it is essential not to over-trade.
